prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-bleed desktop web cover hero for a children's story co-creation game
Primary request: Create an original premium 3D family-animation-film scene of a magical story workshop where a brave young child storyteller and a friendly round fox-like story director stand beside a giant open book, and glowing miniature worlds—castle, jungle, tiny flying whale, moonlit train—rise naturally from its pages.
Style/medium: polished cinematic stylized 3D animation, expressive rounded original characters, tactile paper, fabric and wood, emotionally warm, feature-film lighting; evoke the quality and warmth of major family animation without copying any existing franchise or character.
Composition/framing: 16:9 wide, characters and magical book concentrated on the right 58%; clean darker lavender-blue negative space on the left for Chinese title and buttons; clear foreground/midground/background depth.
Lighting/mood: golden story light spilling from the book, twilight violet studio, wonder and invitation.
Color palette: plum, moonlit blue, coral rose, parchment gold.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no copyrighted characters, no extra limbs, faces clean and child-friendly.
